summary: IKEA is swedish multinational furniture store chain, founded in 1943. Type: private company. About 100,074 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Swedish-founded home furnishing brand with Dutch entities that are IND recognised sponsors; its Amsterdam opening is a senior supply chain role mentioning visas.

culture.text: Huge organisation: about 100,000 people on LinkedIn, and the brand says it unites over 200,000 co-workers worldwide.
Staff mostly come from business, marketing, economics and design backgrounds, often from Lund, Malmo and Stockholm universities.
Retail runs on franchises: jobs under the IKEA name are offered by different companies using the trademark.

open.text: IKEA B.V., IKEA Nederland B.V. and Stichting IKEA Foundation are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Reportedly used AI to reskill 8,500 workers and build a $1.4 billion sales channel.
Opening a small-format store in Gouda.

worth_knowing.text: Closing three small Plan & Order stores in the US Washington DC area.
Launched a gaming furniture collection with Xbox in the Netherlands.
